---
title: "Learning Resources"
description: "Learning material on econometrics and causal inference."
---

+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Causal Inference: The Remix**          | Scott Cunningham                         | [mixtape.scunning.com][mixtape]  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| Introduces the main causal inference designs such as matching, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity and    |
| difference-in-differences with worked examples in R and Stata.                                                         |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **The Effect**                           | Nick Huntington-Klein                    | [theeffectbook.net][effect]      |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| Explains research design and causal identification with an intuitive focus and fewer formulas, using causal diagrams   |
| to build up each method.                                                                                               |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Mastering Econometrics**               | Joshua D. Angrist                        | [learn.mru.org][mru]             |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A free video course on Marginal Revolution University that teaches the five core tools of causal inference in short,   |
| humorous lessons with a kung fu theme.                                                                                 |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Mostly Harmless Econometrics** (2009)  | Joshua D. Angrist, Jörn-Steffen Pischke  | Book                             |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A more technical graduate text that treats regression, instrumental variables, difference-in-differences and           |
| regression discontinuity from the design-based perspective.                                                            |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Mastering ’Metrics: The Path from      | Joshua D. Angrist, Jörn-Steffen Pischke  | Book                             |
| Cause to Effect** (2014)                 |                                          |                                  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| An accessible introduction by the same authors to the five core tools of applied econometrics: randomized trials,      |
| regression, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity and difference-in-differences.                            |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Introductory Econometrics: A Modern    | Jeffrey M. Wooldridge                    | Book                             |
| Approach** (2008)                        |                                          |                                  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A standard introductory textbook that develops linear regression and inference step by step and extends them to time   |
| series and panel data with many applied examples.                                                                      |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Econometric Analysis of Cross Section  | Jeffrey M. Wooldridge                    | Book                             |
| and Panel Data** (2010, 2nd edition)     |                                          |                                  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A rigorous graduate text on estimation and inference with cross section and panel data, covering instrumental          |
| variables, GMM, fixed and random effects and nonlinear models.                                                         |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| **Freakonomics: A Rogue Economist        | Steven D. Levitt, Stephen J. Dubner      | Book                             |
| Explores the Hidden Side of Everything** |                                          |                                  |
| (2005)                                   |                                          |                                  |
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| A popular science book that uses economic reasoning and data to separate correlation from causation in everyday        |
| questions such as cheating, crime and parenting.                                                                       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

[mixtape]: https://mixtape.scunning.com {target="_blank"}
[effect]: https://theeffectbook.net {target="_blank"}
[mru]: https://learn.mru.org/courses/mastering-econometrics {target="_blank"}
